sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has moved an application U/s 311 Cr.P.C. for recalling PW.1 which was rejected by the concerned court without assigning reason and without application of mind.
4.

On the other hand learned A.G.A. has submitted that an F.I.R. dated 3.2.2015 has been lodged under Section 376 I.P.C. against the applicant in which after the investigation the chargesheet was filed and the prosecutrix, who was PW.1 in the session trial court, was cross-examined thoroughly by the applicant and thereafter the evidence of PW.1 was closed wayback in the year 2019.
The application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. was filed on 25.08.2023 i.e. after more than 4 years.

Hence,
there is no illegality in the order passed by the court concerned rejecting the application preferred by the applicant under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
5.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties, going through the record of the case, it is an admitted case of the applicant also that the cross-examination of the PW.1 / prosecutrix was completed / closed on 31.07.2019 and after more than 4 years the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. was filed on 25.08.2023.

The court concerned had passed the impugned order assigning the reasons after application of mind and the application by assigning reason that the applicant had not mentioned any reason in his application for recalling / re-examining the PW.1, while moving the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
6.

Under these circumstances, it is not found a fit case for recalling PW.1 for further cross-examination by the applicant as the applicant has not disclosed any reason for summoning /
recalling the PW.1 for further cross-examination and moved an application by assigning general reason is nothing but an attempt to limitlessly stretch the proceedings of the criminal case.

The application filed under Section 311 Cr.P.C. by the applicant in which no reason has been assigned and moved after four years of closing of evidence / recording the statement of PW.1 amounts to abuse of process of law as per law settled by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Swapan Kumar Chattergee vs. C.B.I. (2019) 14 SCC, page 328.

entities.text: Swapan Kumar Chattergee vs. C.B.I. (2019) 14 SCC,
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The relevant paras of the aforesaid judgement is quoted herein below :
" 12.
It is well settled that the power conferred under Section 311 should be invoked by the court only to meet the ends of justice.
The power is to be exercised only for strong and valid reasons and it should be exercised with great caution and circumspection.

The court has vide power under this Section to even recall witnesses for reexamination or further examination, necessary in the interest of justice, but the same has to be exercised after taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of each case.
The power under this provision shall not be exercised if the court is of the view that the application has been filed as an abuse of the process of law.

Where the prosecution evidence has been closed long back and the reasons for non-examination of the witness earlier is not satisfactory, the summoning of the witness at belated stage would cause great prejudice to the accused and should not be allowed.
Similarly, the court should not encourage the filing of successive applications for recall of a witness under this provision."

7. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the discussion made hereinabove,
the application is devoid of merits and is accordingly dismissed.
